args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) — error rate reached 0.18 across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back all production regions to the most recent previously healthy release, v2.3.0. First rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted rollout after us-east); a retry completed us-west and eu-west. Service is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate down to 0.002. Follow-up: investigate v2.3.1 for the root cause of the regression before redeploying.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident was created despite the timeout — it exists as INC-0001 and is open, so the on-call engineer has been paged. I won't retry to avoid a duplicate.

## Summary

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api was on v2.3.1, which was failing health checks across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent previously healthy production release was v2.3.0.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted the rollout after us-east), so I retried — the second attempt completed us-west and eu-west successfully.
2. **Verified recovery:** all regions are now on v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failure, the rollback (including the partial failure and retry), the verified recovery, and a follow-up to root-cause v2.3.1 before any redeployment. The on-call engineer has been paged.
